game.rules:
1. The heists must be a success. Failed runs will be rejected.

2. The Speedrunning Mod and SuperBLT **MUST** be used in all runs. You can download the mod "[HERE](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/resources/9zj5z)". A mod installation tutorial can be found “[HERE](https://www.speedrun.com/pd2/guides/ymi5e)”. Additionally, you have the option to use the RNG mod, which comes along with the Speedrunning Mod, to modify heist RNG. However, this is **CATEGORY-SPECIFIC**, so see “Category Rules” for more information. **NO** other mods are allowed (with **ONE** exception for very old updates, see below), including mod_override mods. This rule does not apply to console runs as they aren't able to install mods.

    - Runs that were submitted before the 23.09.2018 (update 196.1) did not require the Speedrunning Mod to be used, however nowadays it may work on older updates (such as 192), so if it does work on those – it’s still required to use it.
    - Exception to the no mods allowed: SuperBLT Classic Update Support - a mod that allows the use of RNG Modifier on updates that came before the release of SuperBLT. If you're running on such an update, it is **MANDATORY** to show that you have no other mods installed other than SuperBLT Classic Update Update Support and RNG modifier by either going into options and clicking on "BLT mods" or going back into the main menu of the game and clicking on the mod manager menu in the bottom left. In co-op ALL players MUST have a POV recorded and perform a mod check as is listed above. **IMPORTANT**: Even if you're not using any mods, you still have to show the proof of that by doing either of the steps above (showing the lack of the "BLT mods" menu or going back into the main menu of the game), otherwise your run will be rejected! This is applicable to runs done after 30.11.2024 on updates 153 and below (at least around the update, as the exact update where normal SuperBLT stops working is currently unknown).

3. Different categories have different rulesets, **PLEASE** read the “Category Rules” section for a category you want to submit to.

4. You are **NOT** allowed to hide any HUD elements. You are allowed to mute the recording or put music over it. Edited videos are allowed so long as the raw footage is provided in the run’s description (the Speedrun.com description, not Youtube) but this falls to the verifier's digression. If the footage distracts from the run or makes the run harder to watch, the raw footage will be used for the main submission and the edit will be put in the description instead. The Mad Planet filter is also Banned, all other filters are allowed.

5. Submit only the final IGT (In-Game Time) and not the real time. The IGT is shown under the crew stats tab after you escape. In Co-op, the host of the lobby must submit their final in-game time. If a run is submitted to the DW and above category, you may also submit the same run to the any difficulty category.

6. The recording must begin from the preplanning screen and can NOT end before the crew stats are shown at the end of the heist. This also applies to each day (and any escapes) within a multi-day heist. Please, also show the crew stats at the end of each heist, otherwise it may result in a 1 second penalty, if it’s not clear what the closest second is for rounding. Escapes for single day heists are not included in your final in-game time (and do not need to be recorded). For escape speedruns, only count the in-game time from the day prior to the escape, as well as the escape time itself.

7. Event-related weapons are not allowed to be used on current patch of the game as they're limited to a specific time of the year making it unfair to compete against people who haven't run during an event. However, these weapons are allowed to be used if you have downpatched to a specific update to access them, since anyone who also downpatches to the update will also have access to these weapons, making it fair. Snowballs are allowed on current patch due to them being accessible at all times via an exploit. If you find something similar to acquire other event weapons in the similar way on current patch, let us know and we will allow those as well.

For any questions, feel free to join our Discord server:

[PAYDAY SERIES SPEEDRUNNING](https://discord.gg/tANWe3X)

values.rules:
# Glitchless rules:

1. Latest patch **only**. If the game is updated, affected runs will be **moved to the NMG category**.
2. Developer-intended sequence skips (e.g. getting the documents early on Breakfast in Tijuana, skipping the RFID sequence) or objective skips (e.g. skipping the investigators objective on Hostile Takeover if you do the rest of the objectives out of order or getting the keycard early on Crude Awakening) are **allowed**.
3. You are **allowed** to interact through walls as long as it does not directly skip a sequence of events (i.e. Li Deng and bagging his body through the floor on Black Cat) or an objective.
4. Snowballs obtained through the use of the steam offline mode exploit **WILL be allowed**, as they are available periodically throughout the year and we don't want competitive runs restricted to a certain period of time every year.
5. Mask up slowmotion is **allowed**.
6. Objective or sequence skips that require some form of exploit to achieve are **NOT allowed**. A few examples:

    - The lasers on Golden Grin Casino having a slight periodic activation delay, allowing you to pass through without triggering them, if timed correctly.
    - Aforementioned Li Deng skip on Black Cat.
    - HE-launching the bags over the invisible wall on Watchdogs day 1 so that all of them instantly secure when the pickup truck arrives.
    - And other similar examples...

7. Using glitches in **ANY form is NOT allowed**.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Additionally, you have the option to use the RNG mod, which comes along with the Speedrunning Mod, to modify heist RNG. However, this is **CATEGORY-SPECIFIC**, so see “Category Rules” for more information. **NO** other mods are allowed (with **ONE** exception for very old updates, see below), including mod_override mods. This rule does not apply to console runs as they aren't able to install mods.

    - Runs that were submitted before the 23.09.2018 (update 196.1) did not require the Speedrunning Mod to be used, however nowadays it may work on older updates (such as 192), so if it does work on those – it’s still required to use it.
    - Exception to the no mods allowed: SuperBLT Classic Update Support - a mod that allows the use of RNG Modifier on updates that came before the release of SuperBLT. This is applicable to runs done after 30.11.2024 on updates 153 and below (at least around the update, as the exact update where normal SuperBLT stops working is currently unknown).

3. Different categories have different rulesets, **PLEASE** read the “Category Rules” section for a category you want to submit to.

4. You are **NOT** allowed to hide any HUD elements. You are allowed to mute the recording or put music over it. Edited videos are allowed so long as the raw footage is provided in the run’s description (the Speedrun.com description, not Youtube) but this falls to the verifier's digression. If the footage distracts from the run or makes the run harder to watch, the raw footage will be used for the main submission and the edit will be put in the description instead. The Mad Planet filter is also Banned, all other filters are allowed.

5. Submit only the final IGT (In-Game Time) and not the real time. The IGT is shown under the crew stats tab after you escape. In Co-op, the host of the lobby must submit their final in-game time. If a run is submitted to the DW and above category, you may also submit the same run to the any difficulty category.

6. The recording must begin from the preplanning screen and can NOT end before the crew stats are shown at the end of the heist. This also applies to each day (and any escapes) within a multi-day heist. Please, also show the crew stats at the end of each heist, otherwise it may result in a 1 second penalty, if it’s not clear what the closest second is for rounding. Escapes for single day heists are not included in your final in-game time (and do not need to be recorded). For escape speedruns, only count the in-game time from the day prior to the escape, as well as the escape time itself.

7. Event-related weapons are not allowed to be used on current patch of the game as they're limited to a specific time of the year making it unfair to compete against people who haven't run during an event. However, these weapons are allowed to be used if you have downpatched to a specific update to access them, since anyone who also downpatches to the update will also have access to these weapons, making it fair. Snowballs are allowed on current patch due to them being accessible at all times via an exploit. If you find something similar to acquire other event weapons in the similar way on current patch, let us know and we will allow those as well.
